gaps.category: Online platform sellers and livestreaming e-commerce merchants (tax reporting, platform rules)
gaps.first_search: 平台企业涉税信息报送 个体工商户 网店 直播带货 2025 税务 合规
gaps.why: Millions of small sellers/micro-sellers on Taobao, Pinduoduo, Douyin, WeChat shops. The 2025 SAT/SAMR platform income-reporting rules (网络交易平台涉税信息报送) and livestream merchant/anchor tax duties hit tiny sole traders at once; only e-invoicing was screened and rejected as generic, not this reporting duty.

gaps.category: Individual businesses (个体工商户) and micro-firms: annual report, deregistration, social insurance and 2025 Company Law compliance
gaps.first_search: 公司法 认缴出资期限 5年 2027年6月30日 小微企业 减资 注销 年报 个体工商户
gaps.why: About 120 million registered individual businesses; the 2024 Company Law capital paid-in deadline (5 years, by 2027-06-30) forces many small firms to adjust capital or deregister; the annual report on the credit publicity system is mandatory. Only co-operative annual reports were covered.

gaps.category: Food business licensing and small producers: food-safety self-inspection, catering licence, food-producer records (小作坊, 小餐饮, 小食杂店)
gaps.first_search: 食品安全总监 食品安全员 日管控 周排查 月调度 餐饮服务提供者 小餐饮 记录 要求
gaps.why: China has millions of small restaurants, snack shops and workshops. The 2025 revised Food Safety Law implementing regs and the 'Chef in charge / food safety director' (食品安全总监, 主要负责人) duties and daily/weekly/monthly risk-control records (日管控、周排查、月调度) apply to catering and small food firms. Only used-oil handover, markets and small slaughter were screened.

gaps.category: Private schools, tutoring and training bodies, and small education firms (non-academic training filing, prepaid fee supervision)
gaps.first_search: 校外培训机构 预收费监管 资金托管 非学科类 审批 备案 小微机构 2025 平台
gaps.why: After the double-reduction policy, non-academic tutoring, art, sports and driver training bodies must hold licences and use prepaid-fee escrow supervision platforms; hundreds of thousands of small operators face filing and funds supervision. Only nurseries and driving schools were mentioned.

gaps.category: Export/import micro-operators: cross-border e-commerce sellers, 9610/9710/9810 customs declaration and export tax refund filing
gaps.first_search: 跨境电商 出口 9810 9710 海关申报 出口退税 小微 卖家 合规 2025 2026 市场采购贸易 备案
gaps.why: Hundreds of thousands of small cross-border sellers and yiwu-style micro-exporters must file customs data, FX receipts and export VAT refund/exemption reports. The 2025-2026 changes on cross-border e-commerce export tax and the Yiwu market-procurement (市场采购贸易) rules create a deadline-driven filing load. The export lens was only covered for aquaculture and CBAM.

gaps.category: Courier, express and logistics sub-stations (快递末端网点, 驿站): real-name registration, inspection-before-sealing, security screening
gaps.first_search: 快递 末端网点 实名收寄 收寄验视 过机安检 驿站 备案 快递暂行条例 修订 2025
gaps.why: Hundreds of thousands of small franchise outlets and community delivery stations (驿站) must do real-name collection (实名收寄), 'three-in-one' checks (收寄验视, 实名收寄, 过机安检), and register with the postal regulator under the revised Express Delivery Regulations (2025 amendments). The postal and delivery-station sector is full of small operators and was not screened.

candidates.buyer: Pilot-licensed small and micro hazardous waste collection units (service providers) and the auto-repair shops, labs and workshops under 10 tonnes a year that they serve
candidates.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
candidates.evidence: https://www.mee.gov.cn/xxgk2018/xxgk/xxgk06/202512/t20251231_1139520.html (fetched: extension to 2026-12-31, year-end summary to MEE, information tools to record type, quantity, destination); https://www.mee.gov.cn/xxgk2018/xxgk/xxgk06/202311/t20231113_1055765.html (2023 pilot notice, collectors offer plan, ledger and declaration help); https://www.mee.gov.cn/ywdt/zbft/202206/t20220630_987258.shtml (HJ1259-2022 tiering: under 10 tonnes is registration-managed); records kept 5 years (Chongqing inspection sheet, https://ws.cq.gov.cn/bm/hbj/zwgk_70287/fdzdgknr_70290/jdjc/jcyjjbz/202409/W020240909583100166154.pdf)
candidates.existing: Competitor search 'hazardous waste ledger software small producers' found no named product for small and micro producers. Only service-provider promotion and a Shanghai government system upgrade tender. The national system has a built-in electronic ledger that auto-generates the declaration, which is a free alternative.
candidates.known_note: Related only by farm-input waste angle; different buyer and duty.
candidates.name: Small-producer hazardous waste desk: management plan, ledger, declaration and e-manifest done-for-you for small and micro waste producers and pilot collection units
candidates.trigger: HJ1259-2022 requires a management plan and ledger. Producers declare through the national solid waste information system and run electronic transfer manifests. Under the MEE pilot (extended to 2026-12-31) collectors are told to offer plan, ledger, declaration, QR-label and 'reverse' e-manifest filling to small firms.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the pilot becomes permanent after 2026 (policy 'to be studied' in the 15th Five-Year Plan). Whether the free national and provincial electronic ledger already covers small producers. Pilot-collector counts per province. Whether hazardous waste SaaS vendors serve small collectors. Foreign-ownership/ICP issues of K04 may apply to an online service.

candidates.buyer: Small independent pet clinics and animal hospitals (動物診所), including chains' branches needing separate licences
candidates.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
candidates.evidence: https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7030351.htm (listed in results; content paraphrased by the search tool, not opened); https://www.zhonglun.com/research/articles/9212.html (compliance points, branch licences, vets filed outside their county penalised); https://www.fadada.com/article/Basics-014388 (2022 measures text)
candidates.existing: Competitor search found clinic management apps, for example 它它医生 (app store listing: billing, appointments, drug expiry, prescriptions, hospitalisation). Not shown to handle the annual report or vet filing.
candidates.known_note: K03 covers veterinary medicine ledgers at farm-input shops; this is a different buyer (diagnostic practices) and duty.
candidates.name: Pet clinic and animal hospital compliance desk: new e-licence, vet filing, prescription format and annual report
candidates.trigger: MARA notice 農辦牧〔2025〕20號: new electronic animal diagnosis licence from 2025-09-01 on the national veterinary information platform, full filing of employed licensed vets, prescriptions kept in the prescribed format, annual report used for supervision. 动物诊疗机构管理办法 (MARA order 2022 No.5, in force 2022-10-01).
candidates.unchecked: Whether the annual report is online and free in the national platform. Number of independent clinics. Whether leading clinic SaaS (and chains) already cover vet filing. Electronic prescription requirements not confirmed.

candidates.buyer: Small private 托育 centres and community childcare points
candidates.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: nurseries
candidates.evidence: https://wjw.fujian.gov.cn/xxgk/zfxxgkzl/zfxxgkml/bwgfxwj/202101/P020210104425450553945.docx (Fujian filing and change rules); https://wjw.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/gzhgfxwjsjk/gfxwjsjk/202306/P020241212355869997973.doc (Guizhou materials); https://hljhulin.gov.cn/hls/c100902/202512/350515/files/关于开展全国托育服务质量提升行动（2025-2027年）的通知.pdf (2025-2027 action)
candidates.existing: Competitor search found nursery management and enrolment apps (爱托育, 托育到家 listings). Not shown to handle filing. Filing itself is done in the government system.
candidates.name: Nursery and infant care centre filing and change tracker
candidates.trigger: Mandatory filing with the county health authority through an online system. Change filing when head, service form or places change. Lease of at least 3 years, health evaluation and fire documents. 2025-2027 national quality action targets higher filing rates.
candidates.unchecked: Annual reporting or re-checking duties. Number of unfiled centres. Pay willingness. Whether a licensed ICP is needed (K04 logic).

candidates.buyer: Gold recycling shops and small jewellers who buy back used gold
candidates.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
candidates.evidence: https://m.gmw.cn/2026-02/26/content_1304356310.htm (as summarised by the search tool; page not opened)
candidates.existing: No competitor search run.
candidates.name: Gold recycling shop seller-ID register
candidates.trigger: Feb 2026 Shanghai Gold Jewellery Association letter, based on a prosecutor's recommendation after a robbery-murder where fenced jewellery was bought without checking ID or receipt. Advice to check and record seller ID and keep images; Shanghai standard DB31/T1262-2020 on gold recycling points.
candidates.unchecked: Whether any mandatory national or provincial rule exists. Police-system integration. Competitors. This is advice, not a mandatory rule, so the duty may be weak.

candidates.buyer: Small pig slaughter sites in remote counties of Yunnan (and any province copying the model)
candidates.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
candidates.evidence: https://nync.yn.gov.cn/uploadfile/s38/2025/1229/20251229060049920.pdf and https://nync.yn.gov.cn/uploadfile/s38/2025/0917/20250917050549734.doc (as summarised by the search tool; files not opened); national cap 'only decrease, not increase' per county (2019 MARA notice)
candidates.existing: No competitor search run.
candidates.name: Yunnan small pig slaughter site record kit
candidates.trigger: 云农规〔2025〕4号 (2025-12-26): sites listed publicly; incoming-pig checks, inspection, outgoing product records, recall and harmless treatment duties; official vet posted by county; slaughter licence valid up to about 3 years in the draft.
candidates.unchecked: Number of sites. Whether sites keep paper or use the provincial system. Offline access in remote counties. Other provinces' small-site rules. Competitors.

candidates.buyer: Operators of small farmers' markets and wet markets, and their stall holders
candidates.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
candidates.evidence: https://www.bjnews.com.cn/detail/1780546516019895.html (Beijing 2026 enforcement, via search summary); https://www.shaanxi.gov.cn/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/zcwj/gfxwj/202209/W020220901617513267265.pdf (Shaanxi rules encourage electronic archives); https://amr.sz.gov.cn/attachment/1/1482/1482647/9772236.pdf (Shenzhen smart-market requirements)
candidates.existing: Competitor search 'agricultural market management software': no commercial product named. Only local smart-market standards (management, stall-holder and consumer subsystems) and local government traceability systems.
candidates.name: Food market operator file and certificate tracker (sellers' archive, purchase vouchers, 承诺达标合格证)
candidates.trigger: Market operators must keep seller archives (name, ID or credit code, products, source, origin), check supply vouchers and the conformity certificate per batch, and sample-test without papers. Sellers keep purchase ledgers for 6 months or more. Beijing 2026 enforcement targets missing certificates.
candidates.unchecked: Local government systems and municipal traceability platforms may already be mandatory and free. Market-operator budgets. Whether the 2016 order was replaced (a source marks it invalid). Competitors from market-management SaaS firms.

candidates.buyer: Small labour dispatch (劳务派遣) and HR-service firms
candidates.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
candidates.evidence: https://www.pudong.gov.cn/zwgk/14533.gkml_ywl_ldgx/2025/63/338757/04559e3293744c06bee4852d609032ff.pdf (Pudong online filing, no paper needed); https://rsj.xuchang.gov.cn/uploadfile/b95eafb4-c28e-4311-9d42-bf11b1e076eb/20260305170430266.docx (Xuchang 2026 notice)
candidates.existing: Government online filing (Shanghai 一网通办). No competitor search run.
candidates.name: Labour dispatch firm annual operating report pack
candidates.trigger: 人社部令第19号: annual operating report by 31 March; missing or false report means non-renewal. HR-service agencies publish an annual disclosure for 30 days or more. Henan 2026 notice ties the 2025 report to credit grading.
candidates.unchecked: Whether audited financials make a paid prep service worthwhile. Number of small firms. Probably a free-portal gap only.

candidates.buyer: Small property management firms and owners' committees acting as lift 'user unit'
candidates.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
candidates.evidence: https://oss.xinyang.gov.cn/xytyptfile/20250829/0309ea1092ec4cd88fed80b8f3317f2f.pdf (Xinyang enforcement document); https://fgj.sh.gov.cn/cmsres/43/434e94bdf750404986be1de0ba6ac388/1a821b2122507ca8a128c5985d546b38.pdf (Shanghai documents, via search summary)
candidates.existing: Smart-lift platforms run by local regulators (Shanghai 智慧电梯 platform). No competitor search run.
candidates.name: Residential lift remote-monitoring and record keeping for small property managers
candidates.trigger: TSG08-2017: property firm is the user unit. Annual inspection, maintenance records at least 4 years. Shanghai measures require remote monitoring on new lifts and aim for full residential coverage by end 2027.
candidates.unchecked: Maintenance-firm side. Boilers and pressure vessels not screened. Local monitoring platforms already take the duty, leaving little room.

candidates.buyer: Small aerial-spraying (飞防) service teams
candidates.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
candidates.evidence: https://www.pconline.com.cn/ask/17945.html (secondary Q&A, unverified); Ningxia group standard on safe drone spraying effective Jan 2026 (https://www.ttbz.org.cn/Home/PdfFileStreamGet/c3QsMTU0NDU4)
candidates.existing: Drone makers' own operation apps (XAG, DJI) are expected to log flights. Not verified by search.
candidates.name: Agricultural drone spraying team log and permit tracker
candidates.trigger: Real-name registration of drones, pilot certification and flight reporting under the 2024 drone flight regulation (per secondary sources). Pesticide application records. Operating certificate and for-profit flight permit details unverified.
candidates.unchecked: Actual legal duties (no primary source found). Competitors. The regulator's platform is the filing channel.

candidates.buyer: Holders of abstraction permits below the online-metering threshold
candidates.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
candidates.evidence: https://slt.fujian.gov.cn/wzsy/tzgg/202509/P020250930472779675880.pdf; https://www.nanan.gov.cn/zwgk/zfxxgkzl/bmzfxxgk/slj/zfxxgkml/202601/P020260107359544026892.doc (both via search summary; not opened)
candidates.existing: Provincial data-receiving platforms for online metering. Hardware-led. No competitor search run.
candidates.name: Water abstraction metering and annual summary for small abstractors (fish farms, factories, small hotels)
candidates.trigger: Water resource tax fully in force from 2024-12-01 (财税〔2024〕28号). Annual abstraction summary and next-year plan. Random inspections of metering and tax payment in Fujian (Sept-Oct 2025).
candidates.unchecked: Agricultural well rules. Number of small permit holders. Likely hardware-bound and local.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: No duty falls on household employers. The national Domestic Service Credit platform (家政信用查) and the 2021 MOFCOM measures for domestic service agencies (家庭服务业管理办法) bind agencies, not families. Employers only look up records as consumers. Nothing found.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K02 and K10. The 2019 national 再生资源回收管理办法 is still the basis for 2025 local rules. Filing is merging into the business licence (Shanghai). Scrap-metal recyclers still file with district police within 15 days (Shanghai rule). Huainan issued new measures on 2025-08-14. No national 2025 revision found.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawnshops: 典当管理办法 (MOFCOM and MPS order 2005 No.8), with MOFCOM supervising and police managing security. No second-hand-goods (旧货) ledger or police-system rule could be confirmed by search. Mark pawn and 旧货 ledger duties unverified.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Feb 2026: Shanghai Gold Jewellery Association letter after a robbery-murder case, advising shops to check and register seller ID, keep ID copies, and follow DB31/T1262-2020. This is advice from a prosecutor's recommendation, not a national mandatory rule. Candidate G3 below.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Licensed end-of-life vehicle dismantlers: about 1,800 firms (chyxx, unverified). Oct 2024 seven-ministry notice 商消费函〔2024〕592号 allows selling the five major assemblies to remanufacturers and encourages digitisation and online sale of reused parts. The 3-month crackdown covered illegal dismantling. Buyers are licensed mid-size firms, not quiet shops. Nothing clearly new.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Dealers and haulers need 检疫 certificates for pigs and vehicle filing. A 2025 Pingjiang (Hunan) penalty shows enforcement against buying uninspected pigs. The 动物运输防疫管理办法 was only a 2021 draft. The 2022 Animal Quarantine Measures (MARA order No.7) are in force. No software-shaped recurring filing found beyond official e-certificate systems.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Yunnan Small Pig Slaughter Sites Measures (云农规〔2025〕4号, 2025-12-26). Sites are listed publicly, with inspection and delivery records, recall and harmless-treatment duties, and a slaughter licence valid up to about 3 years in the draft. Candidate G4 below. Small sites are capped 'only decrease, not increase' per county (2019 MARA notice).

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Only the 2010 蜜蜂检疫规程 (validity unconfirmed). No Chinese hive-registration or migratory-apiary reporting rule was found in two searches. Treat as no evidence.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: MARA notice 农办牧〔2025〕20号: new electronic 动物诊疗许可证 from 2025-09-01, issued through the 兽医卫生综合信息平台. It requires practices to file their employed vets (应备尽备), follow prescription format rules and file an annual report. Branches need separate licences. Candidate G2 below. Vet-medicine dealer ledgers: nothing new beyond K03.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Water resource tax reform fully in force from 2024-12-01 (财税〔2024〕28号). Fujian 2025 random inspections check abstraction metering and tax. Nanan 2025 metering rules require online metering above a size threshold, with annual summary and plan. Agricultural well rules not found. Mostly metering hardware and local filings. Weak candidate G8.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Strongest finding: the MEE small and micro enterprise hazardous waste collection pilot. It was extended to 2026-12-31 (MEE notice 2025-12-31), with a year-end summary due. Policy for the 15th Five-Year Plan is still to come. Candidate G1 below. Septic and sanitation haulers: nothing specific found.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Property firms are the 'user unit' for residential lifts (TSG08-2017). Shanghai requires remote monitoring on new lifts and aims at full residential coverage by end 2027, with a smart-lift code. Maintenance firms must keep records for at least 4 years. Candidate G6 (weak). Boilers and pressure equipment not searched.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No national rural water supply regulation found. GB5749-2022 sets required test items (27 required, 16 may be exempted per a Nanyang document). Zhejiang rural water measures took effect 2024-02-01. Rural tap-water coverage 96% and scaled-system coverage 71% at end 2025 (MWR). Mostly county-run, with local implementation. Nothing buyer-shaped for a solo founder.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Dealer ledgers: nothing new beyond K03. Drone spraying: pilot licence, real-name aircraft registration and CAAC platform rules are described by secondary sources only. Operating certificate and for-profit flight permit details are unverified. Operators are served by the drone makers' own apps (XAG, DJI). Candidate G7 (weak, unverified).

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Labour dispatch firms must file an annual operating report by 31 March (人社部令第19号). Shanghai Pudong files online. Missing or false reports lead to non-renewal of the licence. HR-service agencies publish an annual disclosure for at least 30 days. Filing is on free government portals. Candidate G5 (weak).

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: The State Council revised the Funeral and Interment Regulation (decree No.824, effective 2026-03-30). No new for-profit funeral service bodies, including commercial cemeteries, may be set up. There are two lists of basic and non-basic items. Hospitals share death certificates through the e-government platform. Existing private operators are a shrinking base. Provincial rules on annual inspection and ash ledgers not found. Nothing buildable.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Social organisation annual reports and inspections run on free civil-affairs portals. Shanghai 2025 cycle: 1 March to 30 June 2026, charities publish on 慈善中国 by 31 May. Late filers go on the abnormal activities list. Halal: no national regulation; local rules (Ningxia halal permit valid 4 years, Shandan, Nanning) with 2025 spot checks. Free government filing and local rules mean thin software demand.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Dynamic monitoring (北斗 and video) targets key vehicles: 12-tonne-plus heavy trucks, hazmat, tour and line buses. Chongqing publishes monthly platform scores for ordinary heavy trucks. Beijing draft on video alarms is a draft. Small trucks and individual owners fall outside. Monitoring platforms are sold by licensed platform operators. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Food market operators must keep sellers' archives and check supply vouchers and the 承诺达标合格证 for each batch. Sellers keep purchase ledgers for 6 months or more. Beijing 2026 enforcement targets missing certificates. Candidate G9. No smart-market commercial product was identified by search (only local standards). Money changers: not applicable, since private foreign exchange dealing is not permitted.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Nurseries: 托育机构 file with the county health authority in an online system. Changes to heads, service form or places need a change filing. The 2025-2027 national quality action wants filing rates up. Candidate G3b. Driving schools: Chongqing tuition supervision platform (渝悦学车, 2025) and a hour-faking crackdown in Fujian. The platforms are mandatory and run by operators. Small food workshops: provincial rules, licences valid 5 years, nothing nationwide. Tattoo studios and hunting outfitters: nothing found, not a licensed activity here.

candidates.buyer: Independent/private single-site retail fuel stations without a retail management system
candidates.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
candidates.evidence: https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100015/c5250350/content.html (SAT interpretation posted 2026-06-08, fetched); https://www.news.cn/fortune/20260611/9fbe3c63a6aa4a9f82ebdcca19ad1e1e/c.html (search result); https://cbgc.scol.com.cn/news/7857395 (vendor-side article on small stations, unverified)

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Strongest deadline find: SAT announcement requires all retail fuel stations to run 'transaction-as-invoice' (交易即开票) by 2026-11-01, via 乐企自用 or 乐企联用 platforms; small stations may use a shared-use platform. Joint opinion on dispenser-cheating control also stresses purchase/sales ledgers. LPG: national standard for traceability QR codes on gas cylinders in force since 2025-06-01 (over 10,000 fillers); local rules (Chongqing 2024) require filling-traceability systems and cylinder files. No small LPG dealer-level workflow tool found.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: New 粮食经营台账管理办法 (国粮粮规〔2025〕437号, issued 2025-12-31, effective 2026-04-01) obliges grain buyers, storers, processors, sellers and feed/industrial users to keep ledgers (3-year retention) and report basic data; simplified ledger for grain brokers and cooperatives. No ledger software or mini-programme found. Coffee/cocoa not screened separately (not a major Chinese regulated trade).

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Farmer cooperatives must file annual report 1 Jan-30 Jun on the national credit publicity system (measures amended 2025-03-18 and 2025-11-21); two years without reporting or operating leads to listing and licence revocation (Cooperative Law art. 71), with local mass clean-ups in 2025. Rural credit cooperatives are financial-regulator territory: nothing found.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: NHSA first-half 2026: 330k on-site inspections, 163.5bn RMB... (stated as 16.35 billion yuan recovered per source: 163.5亿元), five-year inspection plan 2026-2030 aims for full on-site coverage of designated providers; traceability code scanning required from 2025-07-01 for insurance settlement. No clinic-specific tool or rule found beyond that; software vendors for dental clinics exist (睿齿云, 牙医管家).

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Pharmacies: drug traceability code scan-and-upload for all drugs from 2026-01-01 (except decoction pieces/granules), codes on receipts; NMPA announcement 2026-09-01 extends full-chain traceability duties; reported coverage 530k pharmacies (79%); small pharmacies and village clinics weak on IT; NHSA to open a free three-code mapping library. Precursors: standard 易制毒 regime (sales ledger 2 years, class-1 sales reported within 5 days); nothing new found.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Only low-reliability sources on a Labour Dispatch Provisional Rules revision (claimed 10% cap, claimed effective 2025-04-01, not verified in official text). No security/cleaning-agency filing duty found. Nothing usable.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Real-name labour registration and wage special accounts are state-platform-driven (Shanghai V3.0 account application online from 2025-12-26; Fujian lets projects under 4m RMB use a mini-programme and skip the special account). Duties sit on main contractors and are served by state platforms; nothing new for small firms.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: New 《房地产从业机构反洗钱工作管理办法》 (MOHURD + PBOC) in force 2025-09-01: developers and brokerages must identify customers, file suspicious-transaction reports to CAMLMAC, keep records at least 10 years. No vendor of AML software for agencies found (Baidu check). Notary/lawyer AML not screened.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K09. Police guest-registration system is mandatory (特种行业许可证, ID verification devices, local minsu rules in Chaozhou, Shantou, Nan'an 2025); from 2026-03-20 foreigners can register online in seven provinces for non-hotel lodging.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Export aquaculture raw-material farms must file with customs (individuals, cooperatives, enterprises may apply); GACC amended foreign-facility registration rules (Order 280) from 2026-06-01 are import-side (foreign exporters, out of scope). Timber and forest-risk: no China-specific small-firm filing found in one search.

coverage.category: 31. Hazardous waste generators (small garages, labs, clinics): management plan, manifests, ledgers
coverage.found: Generators are tiered (key/simplified/registration management, HJ 1259-2022) and declare via the national solid-waste system; small-and-micro hazardous waste collection pilot extended to 2026-12-31 (MEE reply Dec 2025), collectors encouraged to offer plan, ledger, declaration and QR label services for generators under 10 t/year.

coverage.category: 32. Motor vehicle repair shops: electronic health record upload and filing
coverage.found: Transport ministry notice (2022) requires class-1/2 repairers to upload repair electronic records and class-3 data to be collected; local systems (Beijing annual re-filing by 1 Feb) exist. 修连邦 (Guangdong 修炼科技) is a shop system built to upload automatically and is free in the regions it runs in.

coverage.category: 33. Employers with occupational hazards (small factories): hazard declaration, testing, health checks
coverage.found: Hazard declaration to the national NHC system is a legal duty, renewed annually; 2022-2025 campaign targets 100% declaration/testing/checks for supported small and micro firms by end 2025; firms with under 10 workers left to provinces. No software or service found.

coverage.category: 34. Restaurants: used cooking oil and food-waste handover manifests
coverage.found: Local rules only (Shanghai handover manifest, Sanmenxia measures effective 2026-02-01, Beijing draft 2026); no national small-restaurant tool or filing.

coverage.category: 35. Small premises fire safety ('nine small premises'): maintenance, inspection and shared fire control rooms
coverage.found: 2026 State Council opinion on grassroots fire safety pushes unit self-management, risk-based and non-site supervision, and government-bought shared fire control rooms for nine-small premises; local campaigns run to mid/end 2026. No annual-report or filing duty found, so mainly government-driven.

coverage.category: 36. Liquor and tobacco retailers (small shops): licences and purchase ledgers
coverage.found: Commerce ministry industry standards SB/T 10391/10392-2026 for liquor wholesale/retail in force 2026-07-01 (traceable purchase ledger 3 years, separate storage, staff training). They are recommended standards, not enforceable penalties. Tobacco licence regime unchanged.

coverage.category: 37. Dental and small clinics: radiation licence, personal dose records, medical waste
coverage.found: Dental clinics with class-III X-ray devices need a radiation safety licence from the environment bureau (Xuchang 2026 approval example) plus radiological diagnosis licence; inspections flag dose-record gaps. Medical waste ledger rules not found.
